title: Fieldscapes: Field Boundaries for South Africa
description: Ground reference crop type labels for an agricultural area in Western Cape, South Africa, with field boundary polygons and crop classification data from the 2018 growing season.
readme:
## README.md
## Description

This dataset contains ground reference crop type labels in an area located in Western Cape, South Africa.


- **Source Data Curator:** [European Space Agency](https://beta.source.coop/esa/fusion-competition/)
- **Source Data Provider:** [European Space Agency](https://beta.source.coop/esa/fusion-competition/)
- **Converted by:** Kerner Lab (ASU)
- **License:** CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326
- **Dataset Validity:** 2018


--- 

## Attributes

| Property                  | Data Type |
| ------------------------- | --------- |
| id                        | string    |
| determination_datetime    | datetime  |
| geometry                  | polygon   |
| area                      | float     |
| perimeter                 | float     |
| crop_id                   | string    |
| crop_name                 | string    |
